card.title: Elastic potential energy
card.says: the energy stored in an ideal spring of spring constant $k$ stretched or compressed by $x$ from its natural length. Because $x$ is squared, stretching and compressing by the same $|x|$ store the same positive energy.
card.from: the triangular area under Hooke's law $F = k x$ from $0$ to $x$: $W = \dfrac{1}{2}(\text{base})(\text{height}) = \dfrac{1}{2}(x)(k x) = \dfrac{1}{2} k x^2$.
card.useWhen: a spring or elastic band is stretched or compressed within its elastic limit and you want the energy stored or released.
card.example: Compressing a spring of $k = 200\text{ N/m}$ by $x = 0.1\text{ m}$ ($10\text{ cm}$) → $E_{ps} = \dfrac{1}{2}(200)(0.1^2) = 1\text{ J}$.
card.analogy: Drawing a bowstring back gets harder the farther you pull—pulling twice as far stores four times the energy ready to launch the arrow.
